mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.price), 0) AS totalAccumulatedRevenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN e.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN t.price ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last30DaysAccumulatedRevenue FROM trainings t JOIN enrollments e ON t.training_id = e.training_id WHERE t.trainer_id = #{trainerId}

SELECT t.training_id AS training_id, t.title AS training_title, COALESCE(t.price * COUNT(e.enrollment_id), 0) AS accumulated_revenue, COALESCE(t.price * SUM(CASE WHEN e.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS last_30_days_accumulated_revenue FROM trainings t LEFT JOIN enrollments e ON t.training_id = e.training_id WHERE t.trainer_id = #{trainerId} GROUP BY t.training_id, t.title, t.price ORDER BY t.training_id

SELECT DATE(e.created_at) AS revenue_date, COALESCE(SUM(t.price), 0) AS daily_revenue FROM trainings t JOIN enrollments e ON t.training_id = e.training_id WHERE t.trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND e.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY revenue_date ORDER BY revenue_date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(e.created_at, '%Y-%m') AS revenue_month, COALESCE(SUM(t.price), 0) AS monthly_revenue FROM trainings t JOIN enrollments e ON t.training_id = e.training_id WHERE t.trainer_id = #{trainerId} GROUP BY revenue_month ORDER BY revenue_month

SELECT DATE(e.created_at) AS revenue_date, COALESCE(SUM(t.price), 0) AS daily_revenue FROM trainings t JOIN enrollments e ON t.training_id = e.training_id WHERE t.trainer_id = #{trainerId} AND t.training_id = #{trainingId} AND e.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY revenue_date ORDER BY revenue_date
